items.title: Anyone moved off Corso for shipping protection? What did you go to?
items.summary: We've been on Corso for package protection for a while now. It's ok, but I'm reevaluating the whole post-purchase setup and wondering what else people run. Mostly I'm tired of protection sitting in its own silo, separate from returns and tracking. If you've switched off Corso, what did you move to, and did it actually simplify anything or just trade one app for another?   submitted by   /u/AnyPuzzleLeaf [link]   [comments]
